name: Gild Hall
positioning: Gild Hall, A Thompson Hotel: a boutique hotel in Lower Manhattan's Financial District with midcentury-modern interiors by Jim Walrod and an Italian restaurant and wine bar
best_for: Travelers who want a Financial District base near Wall Street and the Seaport
Guests who enjoy Italian food and wine on site

facts.text: Gild Hall is in Lower Manhattan's Financial District, steps from Wall Street, One World Trade Center and the Seaport.
The hotel is a short walk from the National September 11 Memorial & Museum, Pier 17 and Battery Park.
Rooms and suites have marble-floored bathrooms.
The 1 King Bed Premium room has 12-foot ceilings and a custom leather headboard with buckle detailing.
The Thompson Suite has a separate lounge area, 12-foot ceilings, a bar and a bathroom with a clawfoot tub.
Felice Ristorante serves Italian classics inspired by rustic Tuscan fare and is available for large groups and private events.
La Soffitta is the hotel's upstairs wine bar.
Gild Hall is pet friendly and welcomes dogs.
The hotel's destination fee includes two welcome glasses of Prosecco per registered guest on arrival and use of vintage-inspired bicycles.
The nearest subway station is Fulton Street, served by the 2, 3, 4, 5, A, C, J and Z trains.

highlights.text: The interiors showcase the design aesthetic of midcentury modern expert Jim Walrod and the photography of Slim Aarons.
La Soffitta wine bar holds a collection of more than 100 Italian wines in custom shelves.
The Penthouse Suite, the hotel's largest, has a dining area for up to eight.
Rooms and suites have custom leather headboards designed by Jim Walrod and 400-thread-count Sferra linens.
The hotel offers Peloton bikes, Peloton rowers and free weights, plus complimentary bikes for exploring the Financial District.

considerations.text: A daily destination fee is charged per room.
Valet parking has no in-and-out privileges, and the garage cannot take large vehicles or pickup trucks.
WhataHotel notes the business-focused location may be quieter on weekends.

sources.title: Gild Hall, A Thompson Hotel, by Hyatt
